summary: BUG: Paid work order shows "Invoiced" status with incomplete line and no reverse option
reported_issue: A specific customer WO (SRP Automotive, S-132 / INV-S-132) that was already paid in full still showed status 'Invoiced' instead of 'Paid', had one line stuck as incomplete, and the Reverse option was missing on the Finance/invoice view, so the invoice could not be reversed.
expected_after_fix: A fully paid work order should show status 'Paid'; lines/statuses should be consistent; and the reverse option should be available where applicable.
steps_i_followed: Inspected a 'paid' WO (S-24674) status and invoice fields.
Opened the paid WO Finance view in the SPA.
actual_now: Staging status transitions are consistent: fully-paid WO S-24674 correctly shows status 'Paid' (open_balance 0). The sampled 'invoiced' WOs all have open_balance > 0 and amount_paid = 0, i.e. they are legitimately unpaid and correctly show 'Invoiced' - none are paid-in-full yet stuck at 'Invoiced'. No paid-but-stuck-at-'Invoiced' inconsistency was found on staging.
notes: The reported defect is tied to one client's specific legacy work order (S-132) whose data was in an inconsistent state (paid but status Invoiced, incomplete line, missing reverse). That production/account-specific record is not accessible on staging and the inconsistency could not be reproduced with staging data. General behavior verified as correct: paid WOs show 'Paid', invoiced-unpaid WOs show 'Invoiced'. Recommend verifying directly against the client's WO S-132 / INV-S-132 whether the status/reverse now resolve.
